agent-architecture-f43eb025.name: Agent Architecture
agent-architecture-f43eb025.description: Maps where agents are defined, configured, managed, and tested across the codebase.
agent-architecture-f43eb025.prompt: Classify each file by its role in the agent system: configuration files that define agents, service implementations that manage them, CLI commands for user interaction, integration points with sessions/plugins, or tests covering agent functionality.

facets.label: Configuration
facets.description: Agent definition files in .opencode/agent/ and config loaders that parse agent markdown files

facets.label: Service & Layer
facets.description: Agent service implementations, Effect layers, and core business logic for managing agent state

facets.label: CLI & Commands
facets.description: Agent command handling and CLI interface for creating, listing, and managing agents

facets.label: Integration
facets.description: Agent integration with plugins, sessions, events, and message types

facets.label: Testing
facets.description: Agent tests, test fixtures, test utilities, and test coverage

tui-features-architecture-1146ff62.name: TUI Features & Architecture
tui-features-architecture-1146ff62.description: Maps TUI features across architectural layers—from core app to context providers, UI components, feature plugins, and utilities.
tui-features-architecture-1146ff62.prompt: Classify each file by its layer in the TUI architecture: the main app and routing layer, state management contexts, reusable UI components and dialogs, full-page routes, modular feature plugins, or utilities and configuration helpers.

facets.label: App & Routing
facets.description: Main app entry point, global routing, keymaps, and app lifecycle (app.tsx, routes setup)

facets.label: Contexts & Providers
facets.description: State management providers for project, editor, theme, sync, SDK, dialog, and other global state

facets.label: UI Components & Dialogs
facets.description: Reusable UI widgets, dialog components, spinners, toasts, and form components

facets.label: Routes & Pages
facets.description: Full-page views and route implementations like home and session screens

facets.label: Feature Plugins
facets.description: Modular feature implementations (session, sidebar, home, system) that extend the app

facets.label: Utilities & Config
facets.description: Helper functions, configuration, editor integration, audio, clipboard, and keybindings

attack-surface-pii-656fc57d.name: Attack Surface & PII
attack-surface-pii-656fc57d.description: Maps code handling secrets, authentication, authorization, external IO boundaries, and cryptographic operations across the codebase.
attack-surface-pii-656fc57d.prompt: Classify files by their role in the attack surface: Secrets & PII (stores or handles sensitive credentials, tokens, API keys, redacts secrets), Auth & Authz (authentication, authorization, permissions, OAuth), External IO (HTTP endpoints, clients, API boundaries, webhooks), or Cryptographic Ops (hashing, encryption, signing, key derivation). Everything else falls into the automatic "Other" bucket.

facets.label: Secrets & PII
facets.description: Stores, transmits, redacts, or manages sensitive credentials (API keys, tokens, passwords, OAuth tokens, private keys)

facets.label: Auth & Authz
facets.description: Authentication middleware, permission rules, OAuth flows, credential validation, and access control

facets.label: External IO
facets.description: HTTP clients, servers, API endpoints, webhooks, and boundaries with external systems

facets.label: Cryptographic Ops
facets.description: Hashing, encoding, signing, encryption, or cryptographic utilities

terminal-performance-bottlenecks-7d814bd.name: Terminal Performance Bottlenecks
terminal-performance-bottlenecks-7d814bd.description: Maps TUI code by likelihood of causing terminal lag—from core render/event loops to features and utilities.
terminal-performance-bottlenecks-7d814bd.prompt: Classify each file by how directly it impacts terminal responsiveness and frame rate. Files in core event loops, render pipes, and animation frames are "Likely"; feature plugins and dialogs are "Possible"; utilities and config are "Adjacent".

facets.label: Likely
facets.description: Core rendering loops, animation frames, event handling, and plugin runtime that directly drive screen updates and input processing.

facets.label: Possible
facets.description: Feature-specific plugins, contexts, and UI dialogs that update frequently or have complex state.

facets.label: Adjacent
facets.description: Configuration, utility helpers, and less-frequently-rendered components.

top-bar-rendering-a9d443de.name: Top Bar Rendering
top-bar-rendering-a9d443de.description: Maps TUI code by likelihood of being the source of top bar rendering issues.
top-bar-rendering-a9d443de.prompt: Classify TUI files by how directly they affect the top bar's rendering. Likely files directly paint the aperture visualization. Possible files manage its container, layout, or dimensions. Adjacent files provide data or styling but don't directly render the bar.

facets.label: Likely
facets.description: Core aperture rendering logic: the aperture plugin, treemap layout, cell rendering, and direct display of the visualization grid/tiles

facets.label: Possible
facets.description: Container and layout management: session layout, flex constraints, viewport sizing, scrollbox configuration, and height/width calculations that might cause aperture to be clipped or misaligned

facets.label: Adjacent
facets.description: Related but indirect: aperture data fetching, lens picker, activity tracking, theme/styling, and event handlers that feed the aperture but don't directly render it
